text.title: Competitive Intelligence Decision Tree
text.summary: Routes on whether a dated baseline exists to diff against and on which surfaces carry this cycle's deltas — to full application, a pricing-controls-first path, or a skip that hands the work to competitor-analysis until a baseline exists.

decision-tree.root-question: Is there a prior-cycle artefact or a dated archived capture for the surfaces in scope, so this cycle's fetch has something to diff against?

branch.when: no prior-cycle artefact and no archive.org or stored capture for any surface in scope

conclusion.verdict: skip; run competitor-analysis first to establish the point-in-time baseline, then return here next cycle to diff against it — with no baseline every field reads 'new' and the delta report degenerates into a first-pass market description

branch.when: the need is a point-in-time picture — who the competitors are, what they offer and what they charge right now — not what changed since a baseline

conclusion.verdict: skip; run competitor-analysis, which is the methodology that produces that artefact; this one reports change over time only

branch.when: fewer than two competitors expose a monitorable public surface, or the only available sources are auth-walled or NDA-bound

conclusion.verdict: skip and record the reason; an unarchivable or single-competitor market cannot produce a re-verifiable delta

branch.when: a dated baseline exists and the question is what changed since it
branch.question: Are competitor pricing pages among the surfaces being diffed this cycle, or only changelogs, job boards, filings and positioning copy?

conclusion.verdict: apply, and clear every pricing diff through the controls before it is recorded: clean session, a second geo/currency, the second billing period — anything that vanishes under a control is logged as `not-a-delta`

branch.when: non-pricing surfaces only — changelog, release notes, job boards, filings, homepage and ad copy

conclusion.verdict: apply the full methodology; each source polls at or above its own publication rhythm, every delta carries two dated captures, a theme needs two deltas from two source types, hiring rows assert direction and timing only, and each implication names a decision and a numeric trigger
